ModMetaData.name: Harmony 3 Strict Binding Compat (local)
ModMetaData.author: sammael
ModMetaData.description: Local stop-gap fixes for RimWorld 1.7 (Harmony 3, UnityStubs). Remove each one when the mod it covers is fixed. Same list as the README on GitHub. Every C# fix fingerprints the method it touches and logs a red error when that mod updates; XML fixes fail loudly the same way. - Biomes! Caverns (Caveworld Flora): wild fungus colonies regrow (each removed mushroom lowers its colony's count; on load counts are reset to the live mushrooms). - Biomes! Caverns (Caveworld Flora): wild fungi mouseover shows growth again instead of "Brightbells)". - Biomes! Caverns: strips the equipment nodes from BMT_ResourceBlueCrystal ("is equipment but has no verbs or tools"). - Loading Progress: its startup profiler no longer races during parallel XML loading (a mod's defs could fail to load and crash the game into a ModsConfig reset). - Loadout Compositing + Better Workbench Management: per-tag bills get the "count pawns away / on caravan" option back (BWM's new Debug build broke LC's transpiler). - Better Workbench Management: its bill options no longer overlap the "Use global style" dropdown (vanilla classic mode or Style Change Anytime). - Better Workbench Management (personal tweak): previous/next bill arrows drawn 7 px higher, clear of the ingredient filter. - Biosculpter Pod and Neural Supercharger Resize + Vanilla Textures Expanded: a resized biosculpter pod shows its resized icon (not VTE's squeezed 3x2 one) on blueprints and the architect button. - Busywork + LTO Colony Groups: "Upper" job icons show on Colony Groups portraits (Busywork only hooked the vanilla colonist bar). - Sensible Bed Ownership: OwnedBed answers cached per pawn until bed ownership changes (was rescanning every bed hundreds of thousands of times a minute); spot-checked against SBO; also used by the parallel render threads, and SBO's bed list scan is locked (sleeping animals in animal beds halved FPS, render jobs threw "Collection was modified"). - Hauler's Dream + Compositable Loadouts: loadout items are kept during surplus unload again (CL's items now list several defs; HD only knew Item.Def). - Hauler's Dream + Smart Medicine - Continued: Stock Up amounts count as kept even on stacks Hauler's Dream tagged as its own haul (no more unload / re-fetch loop and "Cannot unload inventory" alert). - Hauler's Dream + Kanban Stockpile Continue: HD respects Kanban's max stack size when it plans pick-ups and unloads into capped storage (no more overfill / remove-excess churn). - Kanban Stockpile Continue: the similar stack limit counts every stack of the same def when accepting, like its remove-excess job does (no more pawns shuttling unmergeable meals between a capped fridge and the next storage). - Useful Marks: selected items and buildings show one info card button, not two. - Vanilla Ideology + Alpha Memes (heart extraction): sacrificing an innocent prisoner in a ritual no longer counts as executing an innocent or as a prisoner death through neglect (no opinion / mood penalties for the ideoligion's own ritual). - Common Sense: no "random element from empty collection" warnings for food no recipe makes (meal ingredients lookup skipped). - Common Sense: clean-before-eating moves on when its filth is already gone instead of erroring out of the eating job. - Common Sense: pawns on medical bed rest no longer get up to sweep before lying down (tends no longer fail). - Prisoner Realism + Cleaning Area Relaunched: prisoners only clean filth inside the Clean area, no more standing-still Clean job loop. - Hunt For Me: only player animals take hunting jobs (a released animal marked for hunting no longer hunts itself). - Designator Shapes + Better Architect Menu: flood fill stops at doors again. - Vanilla + VFE Pirates: quest raid previews ("raid of roughly this size:") no longer come out blank; pawn groups whose every pawn costs more than the faction allows at those points are skipped (e.g. the melee-only Junker group). - Vanilla Quests Expanded - Ancients (personal tweak): the pneumatic capsule arrival message lists what arrived. - Vanilla Social Interactions Expanded: "cured my friend" thought label resolves for implied relatives (no more template errors or Social tab fallback). - TD Enhancement Pack (personal tweak): the Deteriorating alert leaves out corpses. - UI Rethemed - Animals: hovering a row in a group no longer highlights the same row in the other groups. - UI Rethemed - Inspector Tabs: long opinion rows in hover cards wrap instead of overlapping. - Flourish - Everyday Animations: the telescope pose mirrors with the telescope's art, so a West-rotated telescope is used from the eyepiece side too. - Flourish - Everyday Animations: in the telescope pose the telescope is drawn over the pawn and under its hands. - VFE Tribals + UI Rethemed - Factions (visual tweak): the Cornerstones button is drawn as a UI Rethemed button in the themed Factions title bar. - Show Mod Updates + UI Rethemed - Main Bar (visual tweak): the "N updated mods" menu button gets an icon. - UI Rethemed - Main Bar (personal tweak): left- or right-click on the temperature readout toggles the temperature overlay (Heat Map's colours when it is active). - UI Rethemed - Notifications (visual tweak): the top-left messages are drawn as rows in its bottom-right notification stack, live 30 s, a hovered one stays and shows UI Rethemed's hover card, under a folding "Messages" heading. - UI Rethemed - Quests + Quality Colors (Continued) (visual tweak): quest reward tiles and their hover card titles are drawn in the item's quality colour, and the market value sits on the line under the name instead of beside it. - Auto-Cast Specialist Commands + Det's Xenotypes - Stoneborn (personal tweak): Stonecall is auto-cast when mining or finishing construction, following the Auto-Cast Mining Command setting, which right-click on the Stonecall gizmo toggles (check icon shown). - Vanilla (found through Modern Needs Tab): an emptied minified thing has a label again, so job reports no longer throw and MNT keeps recording job history. - Stem's VWE Industrial Expansion, Fortification Industrial - Citadel: missing weapon sounds pointed at existing ones (pistol equip, sawn-off repeater shot, flame bunker). - Smart Medicine - Continued (personal tweak): the Stock Up picker also lists the VRE Sanguophage animal, corpse and sanguophage hemogen packs, packaged survival meals and nutrient packaged meals. - Smart Medicine - Continued: stocked food-type items such as hemogen packs are no longer dropped by the idle inventory cleanup. - Smart Medicine - Continued: the "use nearby medicine" distance setting is measured in tiles, as its label says (it compared walking cost to tiles, so nearby medicine was never used). - Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage: animalfeeders (strigoi) drink animal hemogen packs on their own, like regular packs, when no prisoner or regular pack is available. - Hospitality: Vending machines (personal tweak): the powered vending machine draws 100 W and keeps stored items frozen while powered. - Mod Settings Framework (VEF): slider settings reach every def their xpath matches, not just the first (ReBuild's grate speed slider now covers the sterile grate tile). - MSS Tweaks and Fun: haunt portraits no longer saved upside down on 1.7/Vulkan. - MSS Tweaks and Fun: VFE Pirates Buckoneer culture patch remapped to the VFEP_Mercenaries faction. - Hospitality: Casino: tables given Casino's vending comp by LocalTweaks (tongo, billiards) charge visitors once per game. - Hospitality: Casino: the inspect pane shows the pricing setting and the silver charged per game. - Hospitality: Casino: only casino visitors and trade caravans at their chill spot play slot machines (bestowers, shuttle guards and leaving caravans keep their duty). - Hospitality: visitors in warcaskets skip the arrival re-gear (casket pieces re-locked) and keep their casket helmet on. - Hospitality: guests no longer sleep on the floor after a save is loaded in the same session (stale per-pawn guest comp cache cleared on load). - Hospitality: guests helping out no longer null-ref in the hopper-filling work giver on food outside the guest area. - Giddy-Up 2: dismounted caravan animals keep their travel/follow target, so the caravan arrives and leaves. - Vanilla/unknown: a caravan guard holding a trader kind counts as the Trader (dismiss works, caravan exits). - Vanilla: visitors and trade caravans no longer leave on arrival "because of dangerous temperature" from hypothermia or heatstroke frozen on them while they were stored as world pawns (it now recovers there at the vanilla off-map rate). - RimPacts: factions whose exiled leader left or was dismissed get a new leader (also repaired after load), no more "Faction leader for X is null". - RimPacts + vanilla gatherings: the expo party host is picked by vanilla's organizer rules (no more party called off moments after it starts because the host is scheduled for work), the host of any party stays through its own work or sleep schedule until the party ends, and every gathering's called-off message names the reason. - VEF (MVCF): multi-verb weapons use the weapon's own accuracy/cooldown when the verb sets none; duplicate stat rows hidden; Range row fixed. - VEF: verb range factor applied to the result instead of the shared verb def (no stuck ranges). - Unburned + VEF: drafted pawns with reach melee weapons auto-attack at full reach again (Unburned replaced the method VEF patches). - Sensible Bed Ownership: reservation prefix skipped for beds with no map. - Skilled Refueling: Harmony 3 unchecked binding for its mistyped __instance patch. - Smarter Visitors + Hospitality: its leave-delay prefix only touches Hospitality's stay timer, not the 1200-tick recovery after a fight (hurt visitor groups no longer stand at their defend point forever instead of leaving). - Basic Traits: "TraitHediffApplier: Processing pawn" debug spam removed. - Triumphant Research: shows the full unlock list instead of a blank window. - Too Many Mods: 22 lowercase "Defs/thingDef[" xpaths fixed (Rimsenal items). - Rimsenal Faction Pack - Spacer: no second style comp on the mech commander helmet, Dresser, EndTable and FloodLight. - Rimsenal - Security Pack (with LocalTweaks): incinerator and graser turrets show their range ring while placing (vanilla ring code null-refs on beam verbs). - Pulse Weaponry (and any weapon with the same mistake): weapons with an ability comp no longer also keep the plain equipment comp, so their verbs stop clashing on load. - ReGrowth plant patches: duplicate wild plant records removed from biomes (world-gen Landmarks/Mutators steps). - Vanilla: no needs while no world exists (quest pawns built before the world loads). - Vanilla: shuttle passengers are no longer evicted (and dropped from their lord) on landing because they last left a map more than a day ago; the one-day eviction now counts time spent inside the shuttle. - Vanilla/unknown: trade ship slave also saved as a world pawn no longer loads twice. - Vanilla + GUI Performance Patch + VEF: small psycast/ability buttons on the top row show their tooltips again. - Vanilla: a failing sibling relation no longer aborts a whole raid group (a RimPacts defend wave froze the game retrying it). - Vanilla (personal tweak): install and implant-removal operations get the implant item as their menu icon instead of a grey square. - Vanilla (personal tweak): clicking a plant pot or hydroponics basin selects the grower first, the plant on a second click.
